description: Initial hand-authored heuristic weights. These are hypotheses to test, not universal design laws.

surfaceSuppliedCapabilities.details-on-demand: a detail pane beside the view that opens the selected mark (interface pattern primary-detail-inspector)
surfaceSuppliedCapabilities.evidence-inspector: a detail pane that shows the sources behind the selected mark
surfaceSuppliedCapabilities.linked-views: one shared selection across the page's views
surfaceSuppliedCapabilities.linked-selection: one shared selection across the page's views
surfaceSuppliedCapabilities.persistent-selection: a selection the page keeps while the reader moves between views
surfaceSuppliedCapabilities.filter: a filter bar that hides the same marks in every view
surfaceSuppliedCapabilities.shared-filters: a filter bar that hides the same marks in every view
surfaceSuppliedCapabilities.search: a search box that finds and selects a mark
